about: RFC 0020: the Unfold Bot type's plugins, recorded from unfold-bot-dsh's src/host/unfold.js (UNFOLD_PLUGINS, in install order) and from each package's package.json at the hand-over commit below, when the Unfold plugins left this repository for Unfold's own. bundlePatch is each manifest's dsh.bundle.patch: declared, so DSH's installBundle can install it. notBundles is carried by Unfold but never installed as a bundle. Read by apps/welcome-dsh/test/unfold.test.js against src/host/bot-types.js (UNFOLD_PLUGINS, UNFOLD_PLUGIN). If Unfold changes its default set, it asks here first, and the list and this file move together.
